source_text: Errat in deserto Bersabee; utrem aquae. Deus aperit oculos — puteum. Vox pueri exaudita.
pass_a_gloss: Wanders in desert Beersheba; skin of-water. God opens eyes — well. Voice of-boy heard.
pass_b_english: She wanders in the wilderness of Beersheba; the water-skin fails. [[God opens her eyes to a well >> Bible:Genesis 21:19]]. The boy’s voice is heard.
